wholePhysicalScope: The NIAH identifies the main entrance and paired lodges as one architectural group. The named gate and two matching building footprints supply the coordinate, north-facing axis, width and depths.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the three arches, two lodges, hipped roof fronts and gateway massing.
limitations: The model covers the main James’s Street entrance and its gate lodges. The larger operating brewery and separate Storehouse building are beyond this model’s footprint.
Roof lines, glazing reflections, the carved keystone head and door joinery are simplified. The date panels represent the standing annual signage.
